LESSON: CHRISTIAN VALUES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to recite Psal
Topic 4.3: Christian Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Christian Values. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. desire to forgive others in their ● Learners to write on flash cards the verse from Colossians day to day lives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. desire to forgive others in their ● Learners to write on flash cards the verse from Colossians day to day lives
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to forgive others in their ● Learners to write on flash cards the verse from Colossians day to day lives. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Christian Values.
2. Explain Christian Values to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Christian Values.
4. Show that you can: desire to forgive others in their ● Learners to write on flash cards the verse from Colossians day to day lives
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian Values. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Christian Values important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. desire to forgive others in their ● Learners to write on flash cards the verse from Colossians day to day lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
